physical_fact: ARM64 SurfaceFlinger aborts with gralloc-mapper is missing while all three planned ARM64 provider files are physically present.

exact_source_flow.GraphicBufferMapper: Tries Gralloc5, Gralloc4, Gralloc3 then Gralloc2 and emits the exact fatal only when all are unloaded.
exact_source_flow.passthrough_loader: libhidl derives prefix android.hardware.graphics.mapper@2.0-impl and symbol HIDL_FETCH_IMapper, scans the process-bitness ODM/vendor/VNDK-SP hw paths, dlopens through SP-HAL, then invokes the fetch function.
exact_source_flow.fetch: The exact r7 2.1 adapter calls GrallocLoader::load(), which calls hw_get_module(GRALLOC_HARDWARE_MODULE_ID), selects gralloc.apollo.so through ro.board.platform=apollo, and returns null if module load or gralloc0/1 adapter initialization fails.
